web-i18n-sync.description: Sync the translation catalogs of a localized web application

web-i18n-translate.description: Write the missing and stale translations of a localized web application to a work file, or apply the filled file as drafts

apply.description: Write the answers of .putnami/i18n/translate.json as drafts instead of writing a new work file.

web-i18n-validate.description: Let a person lock the draft and stale translations of a localized web application they accept

locale.description: Validate this locale only (default: every published locale).

i18n.description: Keep the translation catalogs of a localized web application in step with its messages

sync.description: Add an entry for each new message to locales/<locale>/<namespace>.json, remove the entries of deleted messages and the files of deleted namespaces, and mark stale each translation whose default text changed while keeping its text. Writes only the files that differ

translate.description: Write .putnami/i18n/translate.json with every missing and stale entry of each published locale and its context: the default text, the old default text and translation of a stale entry, the glossary terms and the namespace's other translations. An agent fills it; --apply checks each answer (valid ICU, same arguments and tags, no validated entry) and writes them as drafts, or writes nothing when one is refused. Calls no model

validate.description: Show a person each draft and stale translation next to its default text, and lock as validated the ones they accept, with their git user.name and user.email and the day. Needs an interactive terminal, refuses inside an agent session, and skips a translation whose ICU or arguments are wrong

web-i18n-sync-exec.description: Write locales/<locale>/<namespace>.json for each namespace whose synced catalog differs from its file, and delete the files of undeclared namespaces

web-i18n-translate-exec.description: Write the translation work file, or apply its answers to locales/<locale>/<namespace>.json as drafts

web-i18n-validate-exec.description: Ask a person about each draft and stale translation and write the validated entries. Interactive: it reads the terminal and writes its own output.
